summary: E2E test (public URL, preview DB only) of GC Competition Settings live-apply fix, Free World Pause/Resume and isolated Preview sandbox. Backend: 12 pytest cases (11 pass, 1 fail = real bug). Frontend: GC settings page (GC4 live, status pipeline, read-only schedule cards, no datetime/copy/schedule/activate controls, L1-8 locked), Save Draft -> Apply to Current GC flow via UI (notice lists L9,10 + Champion, L1-8 kept, audit row added, button disabled after), Free World pause/resume UI incl. SCHEDULE_PASSED_DURING_PAUSE resolution box + ack, player /world paused banner, Preview panel (reset, model, game, sim time, open, Memory Match board with clicks/retries/stopwatch, simulate, finalize level + Champion, wallets, error states). Player /world/state reflects applied L9 game (colour_match) while L1-8 stay Number Sequence. Free World left RESUMED. GC4 config restored to the pre-test snapshot (L9 colour_match, L10 number_sequence, Champion colour_match). GC5 config deleted after apply-future test (was absent before).

minor.issue: If the saved draft is identical to the applied config, apply-current returns idempotent_replay=true via the fingerprint branch but never $unset pending_draft. has_unapplied_draft stays true, the UI shows 'ACTIVE · UNAPPLIED DRAFT' and keeps Apply to Current GC enabled forever (each click = no-op). This was already the state of GC4 when testing started (pending_draft saved 13:01 identical to applied). Fix: in the fingerprint-match branch (world_gc_live_routes.py ~line 360) unset pending_draft, or have PUT skip storing a pending_draft equal to the live config.

champion_affected is true on every apply whenever the Champion is unopened and the draft has a champion game, even if unchanged; notice + audit always say '+ Champion' and champion applied_at is rewritten. Compare against the live champion before marking it affected.

For GC4 the sidecar Champion game is colour_match (champion_session_start uses it), but /world/state champion.game_id still reports number_sequence (target_number 30). Players may see the wrong Champion game before it opens. Could not verify the start path because the Champion opens 1 Nov.
Both return 410 correctly, but ~120 lines of unreachable code remain after the raise. Remove it.
There is no pause guard on submit, so a session that was in progress when the pause started can still submit and record hybrid level bests while paused. This may be intended; please confirm.

ui_bugs.issue: errText returns e.response.data.detail as-is. A Pydantic 422 returns an array/object, which React will try to render as a child and crash. Use the same string/message normalisation as WorldGCCompetitionAdmin.
After switching to the Champion level or jumping to another level, the board of the previous level (L1) stays visible.

integration_issues.issue: preview-sim-time only stores sim_now. Levels do not auto-open or close from simulated time; only the manual Open/Close/Jump buttons work.

issues: Locked cards show 'Choose game' with greyed bonus inputs (5/4/3/2/1) even though these levels actually run Number Sequence with no level bonuses. Show 'Number Sequence (existing)' and hide the bonus inputs on locked legacy levels to avoid confusion.
The Season Control card shows a 'DRAFT' badge while Championship 4 is live. This was there before this change but is confusing next to the new pause control.

action_items: Clear pending_draft on the idempotent fingerprint-match path of apply-current (or do not store a draft identical to the live config). GC4 in the preview DB currently has such a stale pending_draft, so the UI shows 'unapplied draft'.
Only mark champion_affected when the champion game/config actually changes.
Make the /world/state Champion block reflect the sidecar Champion game for GC4+.
Normalise error detail in GCPreviewPanel errText to a string.
Remove dead code after the 410 raises in /schedule and /activate.
Optional: clear the preview memory board when the level changes; drive preview level states from simulated time.
critical_code_review_comments: world_routes.py is >13k lines and world_gc_live_routes.py is 787 lines; split these into smaller modules (pause, apply, preview).
Frontend api.js hardcodes the confirmation strings ('APPLY GC{n}'), so the backend's typed confirmation adds no real safety in the UI; window.confirm is the only guard.
PUT competitions allows any admin role to save drafts, while apply requires super_admin. This is acceptable but worth documenting.

Preview sandbox is stored in world_gc_preview_sandboxes keyed by admin user_id. Isolation verified: counts of world_progress/world_game_sessions/wallets/bonus_grants/world_gc_level_bests/world_gc_level_bonus_awards/world_winner_awards and the GC4 contest/config/world_settings docs were unchanged after a full preview run.

The system clock is about 29 Oct 2026; GC4 L1-8 are opened, L9 opens 30 Oct 00:00Z. test_identical_draft_replay_clears_pending is the regression test for the stale pending_draft bug. The pause test always resumes in its finally block.
rca of the issue: Stale 'unapplied draft': PUT stores pending_draft for any active config. In apply-current, when draft_of(config) is truthy and the fingerprint matches last_apply_fingerprint, the function returns idempotent_replay early without $unset pending_draft. has_unapplied_draft stays true, so gc-apply-current stays enabled. Repro: PUT a body equal to config.levels/champion, POST apply-current, then GET shows has_unapplied_draft=true.
